title: 淡马锡投资实习生计划 2027（中国）
contentHtml:
公司名称：淡联投资咨询（上海）有限公司公司性质：民营企业
公司规模：500~1000人公司行业：金融业
职位性质：实习职位类别：金融业务人员
学历要求：本科,博士,博士后,硕士招聘人数：6
工作地点：北京市朝阳区
职位标签：

职位描述


About Temasek

Temasek’s purpose, “So Every Generation Prospers” is our North Star, serving as a single, unifying pledge that encapsulates who we are, and why we do what we do. As a generational investor, we seek to deliver sustainable returns over the long term, with a spirit of doing things today with tomorrow in mind. As a firm, what differentiates us is our commitment to do well, do right, and do good. We are constantly building future-centric capabilities and creating enablers for innovation and growth. Sustainability remains at our core – we need to act now to deliver a better, more inclusive and resilient future for all.？

Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore with a portfolio value of RMB 2.77 trillion (as of 31 March 2026), spanning across a myriad of private and public listed companies as well as diverse industry sectors.？Given our geographic footprint, we hire across continents, including in China.

For information on Temasek, please visit？www.temasek.com.sg.？

Role Overview

Your Journey Starts Here

We welcome students (undergraduates, postgraduate, and PhD students) from all disciplines who are curious about the world, eager to learn, and motivated to make a meaningful impact, to join our Beijing or Shanghai Office. Whether your background is in finance, engineering, science, technology, humanities or beyond, we're looking for individuals who:

Embrace a Growth Mindset

Curious about learning and exploring new ideas

Adaptable in navigating ambiguity and change

Resilient and driven to continuously improve

Demonstrate Leadership Potential

Able to think strategically and see the bigger picture

Proactive in turning ideas into action

Collaborative in achieving shared goals

Embody Our MERITT Values

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates with expected graduation period between December 2027 and July 2028.

Candidates must have the permanent legal right to work in China without requiring employer sponsorship.

Internship Duration

The internship will commence from January 2027 onwards.

A minimum commitment of six months is required, with interns expected to work in person minimally 3 days or 4 days per week at our Beijing or Shanghai office, depending on team requirements. Extensions may be considered based on business needs.

What You Will Experience: Public or Private Investment Tracks

Candidates are required to indicate their preferred track in the application. Both tracks offer hands-on exposure to investment work, the internship exposure will differ based on the type of companies, investment opportunities and projects each team focuses on.

What You Will Experience

Public Investment Team

Private Investment Team

Investment focus

Research listed companies across global public markets, focusing on market trends, sectors and company fundamentals.

Evaluate private companies across sectors and stages, focusing on business models, market opportunities and investment potential.

What you will work on

Analyse company disclosures, results, valuations, news flow and share price movements.

Support sector studies, listed-company research, investment idea generation and portfolio monitoring.

Research companies, industries and markets through benchmarking, market sizing and business model analysis.

Support due diligence, investment materials, transaction execution and portfolio work.

AI and automation exposure

Gain exposure to how AI and automation tools can enhance research, analysis, workflow efficiency, market monitoring and other team related processes.

Ideal candidate profile

Strong interest in public markets, listed companies, business fundamentals and long-term investing.

Relevant experience may include equity research, public markets investing, asset management, investment banking, consulting, corporate finance, financial modelling, accounting, economics or data-driven research.

Strong interest in private companies, business models, market opportunities, growth sectors and transaction-oriented work.

Relevant experience may include private equity, venture capital, investment banking, consulting, corporate development, start-ups, market research, due diligence, financial modelling or project-based analytical work.

We encourage you to apply early, as the application will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Only successful applicants will be notified via email.

https://jobs.temasek.com.sg/job-invite/12148/

关于淡马锡

淡马锡的使命是“延延世代，欣欣向荣”，这是指引我们前行的“北极星”，阐释了我们所承担的角色、坚守的信念和努力的意义。作为跨世代的投资者，我们致力于实现长期的可持续回报，立足当下、放眼未来。作为 n机构，淡马锡的独特之处在于我们坚持“追求卓越、践行使命、造福世代”。我们持续建设面向未来的能力，培养促进创新与增长的能力。可持续发展始终是我们的核心理念——从当下就开始行动，创造更加美好、更具包容性和韧性的未来。

淡马锡是一家总部位于新加坡的全球投资公司。截至2026年3月31日，投资组合价值为2.77万亿元人民币，投资覆盖众多非上市及上市公司，跨越多个行业领域，布局全球。我们在包括中国在内的多个市场招聘优秀人才。

欲了解更多关于淡马锡的信息，请访问：https://www.temasek.com.sg/zh/index。

职位概述

开启你的职业旅程

我们欢迎各专业背景的在校本科生、研究生及博士生申请，包括但不限于金融、工程、科学、技术、人文等专业。工作地点为北京或上海。无论你的专业背景如何，只要你求知欲强、对学习充满热忱，并希望运用所学创造积极影响，我们都期待遇见具备以下特质的你：

秉持成长型思维

保持求知欲，乐于学习新知识、探索新思路

能够灵活应对不确定性和变化

具备韧性，并持续追求自我提升

具备领导力潜能

能够进行战略性思考，并把握全局

主动将想法付诸行动

善于协作，共同实现团队目标

践行淡马锡 MERITT 价值观

申请资格

预计于2027年12月至2028年7月期间毕业的申请人。

申请人须具备在中国永久合法工作的权利，且无需雇主提供工作许可或签证担保。

实习时间

实习将于2027年1月开始，实习期不少于6个月。根据团队要求，实习生每周需至少3—4天到北京或上海办公室现场办公。根据业务需求可考虑延长。

你将获得的实习体验：公开市场投资或一级市场投资方向

申请者须在申请时注明其偏好的投资方向。两个方向均将提供投资相关工作的实践机会，但具体实习内容将根据各团队所关注的公司类型、投资机会及项目而有所不同。

你将体验

公开市场投资团队

一级市场投资团队

投资重点

研究全球范围内的上市公司，重点关注市场趋势、行业动态及公司基本面。

评估不同行业及发展阶段的非上市公司，重点关注商业模式、市场机会及投资潜力。

工作内容

分析公司披露信息、业绩表现、估值、新闻动态及股价走势。协助进行行业研究、上市公司研究、投资观点形成及投资组合跟踪。

通过对标分析、市场规模测算及商业模式研究，开展公司、行业及市场研究。协助进行尽职调查、投资材料准备、交易执行及投后相关工作。

AI与自动化工具应用

了解并实践如何运用AI与自动化工具提升研究能力、分析能力、工作流程效率、市场监测及其他团队相关流程。

理想候选人

对公开市场、上市公司、商业基本面及长期投资具有浓厚兴趣。具备股票研究、公开市场投资、资产管理、投资银行、咨询、企业财务、财务建模、会计、经济学或数据驱动型研究相关的实习经验者优先。

对非上市公司、商业模式、市场机会、成长型行业及交易相关工作具有浓厚兴趣。具备私募股权投资、风险投资、投资银行、咨询、企业发展、初创公司、市场研究、尽职调查、财务建模或项目分析工作相关的实习经验者优先。

建议尽早申请，职位申请将滚动审核。仅通过筛选的申请人将会收到邮件通知。

https://jobs.temasek.com.sg/job-invite/12148/


单位简介


Temasek’s purpose, “So Every Generation Prospers” is our North Star, serving as a single, unifying pledge that encapsulates who we are, and why we do what we do. As a generational investor, we seek to deliver sustainable returns over the long term, with a spirit of doing things today with tomorrow in mind. As a firm, what differentiates us is our commitment to do well, do right, and do good. We are constantly building future-centric capabilities and creating enablers for innovation and growth. Sustainability remains at our core – we need to act now to deliver a better, more inclusive and resilient future for all.

Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore with a portfolio value of RMB2.35 trillion (as of 31 March 2025), spanning across a myriad of private and public listed companies as well as diverse industry sectors.

For information on Temasek, please visit www.temasek.com.sg.
